sections.voiceover: Can 41 older patients with hip and knee pathology undergo camera-based walking tests?
b_roll: Multi-camera motion capture setup in a clinical research lab

sections.voiceover: Leonhard Stein evaluated multi-camera markerless motion capture during walking. How did inter-system reliability score across all 36 parameters?
b_roll: Researchers reviewing patient walking data on monitors

sections.voiceover: Frontiers in Medical Technology published the study, but only eighteen parameters proved excellent.
b_roll: Frontiers in Medical Technology journal publication interface

sections.voiceover: Researchers found that inter-system reliability reached high levels. Markerless motion capture proves reliable for older hip and knee patients during walking assessments.
b_roll: Detailed reliability graph showing 18 excellent parameters

sections.voiceover: Read Denise Maddox's coverage detailing these findings on Scienmag.
